notes.title: DLC and Deluxe Bundle Now Available
notes.notes:
The [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/632160/Gray_Skies_Dark_Waters_Soundtrack__Art_Book/]DLC [/url] for [i]Gray Skies, Dark Waters[/i] (which includes the soundtrack + an art book detailing the decisions that went into making the game's aesthetic) is now available, as is a [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/3625/Gray_Skies_Dark_Waters_Deluxe_Edition/]deluxe edition[/url] that includes both the DLC and the base game! Get the [b]soundtrack/art book for 15% off - that's $1.69 - or the bundle for 8% off, or $8.25. [/b]

Thanks to everyone who's supported us so far by played the game. We're so pleased to continue sharing our work with you!

- the Green Willow Games team
